theorem amc12a_2002_p1 (f : ℂ → ℂ) (h₀ : ∀ x, f x = (2 * x + 3) * (x - 4) + (2 * x + 3) * (x - 6))
  (h₁ : Fintype (f ⁻¹' {0})) : (∑ y ∈ (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset, y) = 7 / 2 := by
  -- Factorize f(x)
  have h_factor : ∀ x, f x = (2 * x + 3) * (2 * x - 10) := by
    intro x
    rw [h₀ x]
    ring
  
  -- Determine the roots of f(x) = 0
  have h_roots : f ⁻¹' {0} = {-3/2, 5} := by
    ext x
    simp [h_factor]
    constructor
    · intro h
      cases' mul_eq_zero.mp h with h1 h2
      · left
        linear_combination h1 / 2
      · right
        linear_combination h2 / 2
    · intro h
      cases' h with h1 h2
      · rw [h1]; ring
      · rw [h2]; ring

  -- Relate the sum over the Finset to the explicit roots
  rw [h_roots]
  simp only [Set.toFinset_insert, Set.toFinset_singleton]
  
  -- Use Finset.sum_insert to compute the sum
  have h_not_mem : (5 : ℂ) ∉ ({-3/2} : Finset ℂ) := by
    simp
    intro h
    field_simp at h
    norm_num at h
  
  rw [Finset.sum_insert h_not_mem]
  rw [Finset.sum_singleton]
  
  -- Final arithmetic
  norm_num
